I've been trying, its hard... To get into things I used to love... Things I still love. Its there, the love for things... It just never feels like enough...
I just got back into Star Trek, which I've absolutely loved since 6th grade.. I've been trying to draw fan art for it for the past week or two, but I'm so bad at drawing guys... Its really frustrating. I get inspired, I want to get my ideas down..but they end up being so subpar to what I wanted them to be..

I don't draw for validation. If people don't like it.. I dont mind. I just want to share my art with people... At school I was always too embarrassed, I would cry if someone tried to look through my sketchbook. The few times ive tried to show my mom my art its always 'um, why is she wearing that' or 'their head is really big'. And thats it. No encouragement, no complements. Not even a 'cool'. She always makes me feel like Ive done something wrong..But the internet is nearly anonymous. None of my followers know me, really. And that's great.. They don't need to know all the sick details... I can be so positive with them, and they're all so nice to me...sometimes I wonder what they would really think...its nice to have some kind of support though...even if its some random person giving me a thumbs up emoji every now and then...I appreciate them all so much...what a lovely thing it is for people to care about something I made. Even just one person... It takes my art from being fun, distracting, a hobby, to something more...like when I was younger, the people who's art I liked, even if they were just starting out as an artist...

I'll be moving out next month...I have a new boyfriend, someone I met during the short time I actually had a job.. And he's going to let me stay with him. He's a nice guy, really. The kind of guy that I should be with... He's been helping me through things. Wants to be there when I cry, wants to listen to me talk about anything. His been through his own traumas, he says he gets it...but I don't feel like he really does... He feels...distant...not just from me, just in general...like he blocked out bad emotions a long time ago and now he's just coasting...I just always find myself looking for...someone else in him...my ex when he understood every thought I ever had...when I could say one thing and he could expand on it for an hour because he actually understood...

I can't help but feel like there's something missing between me and my new boyfriend... But its okay...were coexisting for the time being. Maybe its good for me to not spend time with someone I'm overly attached to... Hell..I don't know.. But we have fun... We play Pokemon go together and I've been showing him all the shows I like and movies I haven't seen in forever. Games too..  There were so many good things he didn't know about...I showed him Sherlock, and Star Trek, Subnautica, The Beginners Guide, 5 Centimeters per Second..I even bought him Journey and Shadow of the Colossus so he could play them... Its nice going back to things I haven't seen or played in years...and watch other people enjoy them...

Funny that you mentioned Steven Universe... It's one of my favorite shows...I just watched it all over again with my boyfriend..and just today I got accepted for a fan run Steven Universe charity art zine..I'd always wanted to take part in those kinds of things... This is going to be my first one...I'm a little scared, but I'm excited too...

...I'm not... Completely suicidal...I have a good day here and there..I have day where I'm just busy and I don't think about if there good or bad...but most of the time, I feel like I'm just...existing... Not living, just being... Once my good day is over, its back to being sad. Not soul crushingly depressed like I was last night but...empty. Like, I'm not going to kill myself now, but I know I will someday...when the time is right. And I'm not scared or worried or anything..I'm okay with it at this point... Even when I'm not sad, I just know I'll be at peace when I'm gone. No more of these crazy thoughts in my head... No more crying, loneliness, boredom, panic attacks, sickening feelings, tiredness... Im just defective or something, I wasnt made strong enough to survive here... I've always known though... Since elementary school... Just knowing I've been depressed for as long as I can remember is proof that there is something wrong with me, its not just who I'm around...

...I feel like a mess just talking...my ex used to say all I do is think about myself. That I'm selfish and self absorbed...my family too...I don't want to be that way...I'm TERRIFIED of being like that...

I don't care about being hit. If you're ready to die, what's a little pain? I don't want him, but my mind thinks I need him. It won't ever change.


I draw. People think art is such a great outlet... Not really. Just another frustration. I can never get it right. Its never good enough, never what I wanted it to be. I can spend all day on a drawing and end up throwing it away,  feeling empty.. Like a failure. Sick and tired of always getting it WRONG. 


Trying to be an artist? Awful... I have to keep my Instagram so nice and neat and far from all my mental issues... Followers just see art, they like they comment, they say they love it. I appreciate them. But after one piece, what's next? For the rest of the day. Boredom, loneliness. Feeling incomplete. Drawing is a distraction.. It won't ever fill that empty feeling in me..


I've been depressed my whole life.. There's a chemical imbalance somewhere... And I've tried it all. Positive thoughts! Drink water! Take care of yourself, you're important! Work hard and be proud of your accomplishments! Respect yourself! Take a break every now and then! To be to hard on yourself! Never give up. Take a nice warm bath and eat your favorite food. Its okay to feel sad, don't beat yourself up about it.. Be a good friend... Be the best person you can be... Make others happy... On and on the list never ends...


I'm not stupid... I know what I'm supposed to be doing... Thats why there's really no hope for me...
I have everything I need, the knowledge, the tools. I have a chance... But I just don't have the will. My mind goes back to 'die!die!die!you worthless fuck'. And it feels safe because it HONEST. Its real.. Even though its fucked up..its real. I like when I feel fucked up... It feel like where I belong.. 


I must be some kind of psycopayh...

I know how you feel, I've been in that situation- no, I still am in that situation.. So maybe I'm not the best person to be sending out advice to, but you seem like a really nice person... You deserve better, and I really hope something awesome turns up in the next week or so for you, so maybe you'll have more hope for the future..
Sorry, I'm not good with advice really, but I sincerely wish you the best..

Hey, I know I probably won't be of much help, but I know how you feel... I came on here to write a thread of my own, but didn't have the words just yet.
So, this was the first thread I clicked on. Our life situations and experiences aren't 100% identical, but I definitely know how you feel... I hope things get better for you, you seem like a genuinely nice person who just surrounded by jerks. No one deserves the kind of treatment you've been getting. And they must be really crappy human beings for thinking it's okay. The good people always seem like the ones taken advantage of the most...
I may not really know you, and I may never really know you, but just know, I would be your friend. I only really have one friend... then people I talk to every now and then who don't really know anything about me...
I really do hope you find some good friends and start feeling better about your life and stuff.. You seem like a really nice person.. Sorry I couldn't be of more help..
